Class OfferTile

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.Board.OfferTile
public class OfferTile extends Object
Represents an Offer Tile in the game board. An Offer Tile provides specific bonuses (such as food or card draws) when a player claims it by placing their totem on it. It also tracks occupancy and player-count requirements.

  • Constructor Details

    • OfferTile

      public OfferTile(int foodBonus, TileId tileId, int topRowDraws, int bottomRowDraws, int minPlayers)
      Constructs a new OfferTile with the specified bonuses and constraints.
      Parameters:
      foodBonus - the amount of food bonus granted by this tile
      tileId - the unique identifier (letter) of the tile
      topRowDraws - the number of cards a player can draw from the top row
      bottomRowDraws - the number of cards a player can draw from the bottom row
      minPlayers - the minimum number of players required in the game to use this tile

    • isAvailable

      public boolean isAvailable()
      Checks if the tile is currently available for placement. A tile is considered available if no player has placed a totem on it yet.
      Returns:
      true if the tile is unoccupied, false otherwise

    • getMinPlayers

      public int getMinPlayers()

      Returns:

    • placeTotem

      public void placeTotem(Player player)
      Places a player's totem on this tile. This action assigns the tile to the player and sets their corresponding drawing capacities for both the upper and lower rows.
      Parameters:
      player - the Player who is claiming the tile and placing their totem

    • restorePlacedPlayer

      public void restorePlacedPlayer(Player player)
      Restores a previously placed player onto this tile without altering the player's drawing statistics. Useful during state restoration or undo actions.
      Parameters:
      player - the Player to be restored on this tile

    • removeTotem

      public void removeTotem()
      Removes the totem from this tile, making it unoccupied. Typically called during cleanup at the end of a game phase.

    • getPlacedPlayer

      public Player getPlacedPlayer()
      Returns the player who has currently placed their totem on this tile.

      the Player instance occupying this tile, or null if it is unoccupied
